reason: The patch touches only six files under services/src/main/java and three test files; nothing under docs/ is changed. It does change behaviour: the tests add `prompt=login` passkey re-authentication cases and the organization test now expects the webauthn form to stay present after username entry (change.patch:196-200), while docs/documentation/server_admin/topics/authentication/passkeys.adoc:8 still says passkeys are available only "in the forms in which the username input is displayed".
